## "The inviting neon glow of the city at night hides danger and opportunity…"

Neon City Nights was a living world-style TTRPG Discord server, meant for online chatroom play-by-post play.

Currently, it stands as the wiki for the Neon City Nights system, which in and of itself is an extension of the [Carbon Pink TTRPG](https://carbonpinkwiki.pages.dev), which itself is a light-hearted, slightly salacious cyberpunk-themed cosmetic overhaul for [Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition](https://dnd.wizards.com/).

Not everything in D&D5E has an immediate equivalent. Neon City Nights expands on base Carbon Pink by often adding items, classes, subclasses, lineages, features and more—often changing core mechanics.

While Neon City Nights uses Carbon Pink's base for its rule system, it does not share its setting. We have an extensive lore section to describe the Neon City itself, which you should read through to help with building your character. Additionally, all of those who wish to flex their dungeon master skills and run games for players in the Neon City Nights server may apply in the server to become fixers, who can then run jobs and missions for potential runners. Both fixers and runners should be familiar with some of the basics of the setting before getting started!

This wiki will occasionally feature adult-oriented lore, features and descriptions. As such, you must be over the age of 18 to peruse this wiki and participate in our community.

If you're completely new to Dungeons & Dragons, check out the basic rules for setting up and playing your first games on the D&D Beyond website here!

# What is Neon City?

Neon City is a massive den of criminal activity, overlooked by corporate overlords that vie for power over one another and have no qualms with hiring mercenaries, dubbed runners or street jukes by the local scene. The city itself is home to all shapes of life, with humans and splicers being the predominant races. Still, Gobbos and Nayalings are sporadic in the streets, Wukongs often take up seats in eateries and entertainment shows, Jerboans and E.L.F.s often make their home in the undercity, Kaijuborn make up the major portion of the Little Big Town, and all walks of Artificiates, Remakes and innumerable others more mingle along as well.

In ancient history, the world seems to have come together in the wake of a world-ending cataclysm over a millennium and a half ago. However, in the middle of the 13th century, due to the discovery of many old-world relics, traditional human irresponsibility gave rise to a corporate sex dystopia. Now, in the year 1624, pseudo-vampire plagues crowd government funded, corporate-controlled mega brothels. The majority of the populace is kept complacent with excessive amounts of sex in their advertising, entertainment, food, cybernetics and all other facets of their often-empty lives. Deep interpersonal bonds and a sense of purpose are truly difficult to cultivate in a place where you are never more than two steps away from your next major hit of serotonin.

As a player, you are playing an exception. You'll be playing a runner, mercenary or street juke. You are likely someone that's had enough of the current system—or someone who wants just a little more out of life then the mind-melting, controlled ease that corporations offer the masses. You may have no qualms working for those very same corporations to attain these goals, or perhaps you will stop at nothing to see one—or all—of them burn.

Whatever your story may be, you've joined the ranks of misfit streamers, ronin, influencers, machinists, enforcers and many others that live on the fringes of the so-called law.

Welcome to Neon City.█
